name: Brooks Price Action Knowledge Base
purpose: Domain knowledge for AI-assisted price-action analysis and quantification

files.purpose: terminology verified against official source; seven common misreadings
published quantification cases per concept; folklore source-checking
academic evidence on TA/PA predictability; positions this KB (see section 14)
open-source implementations, licenses, and repainting pitfalls
backtest validation: PBO, MinBTL, DSR, purged CV, cost realism, minimum evidence standard
cost, data integrity, execution assumptions (project-measured fee/funding magnitudes)
empirical distribution baselines for bar features (project-measured)

usage_rules: Read 16_academic_evidence.md section 14 BEFORE expecting this KB to describe a profitable method. This KB is a tool for making the method testable, not a validated edge.
Use 08_ai_reasoning_protocol.md for chart analysis and explanation.
Use 10_failure_modes.md as a mandatory review checklist.
Use 14_brooks_terminology_verified.md before coding any Brooks term: check the term has not been reduced to a bar pattern (e.g. H2 is a leg count, not the second bar).
Treat every probability figure attributed to Brooks as HIS ESTIMATE, never as a measured statistic (14 section 4).
Check 15_quantification_case_library.md section 9 before repeating any 'commonly known' price-action statistic.
Do not treat operational definitions as proven profitable strategies.
Use 13_price_action_factors.md to translate concepts into interpretable, testable factors before trading signals.
Use 18_validation_playbook.md section 12 as the acceptance gate before believing any result.
Before any backtest, read 19_cost_data_and_execution.md section 2: compute fee/R for the chosen symbol and timeframe first.
Use 20_bar_feature_calibration.md to set thresholds as quantiles rather than absolute values, and to estimate a rule's trigger frequency without backtesting.
Never code a swing/pivot from a library's raw output: all such libraries repaint (17 section 2). Store pivot_idx and confirmed_idx separately.
